propositions: Focused prerequisite consistency criteria must route only through a dedicated finder and verifier pair receiving isolated subject-to-prerequisite judgments, never through general criterion requests, and must use exact canonical prerequisite IDs and plan text only in the two focused prompts.

Every readable pinned prerequisite must receive exactly one stable disposition (consistent, finding, or indeterminate) from the finder; findings carry authoritative prerequisite_id matching the enclosing record; verifier attribution (yes/no/na) is yes only when evidence supports the exact subject-to-prerequisite pair.

Any indeterminate prerequisite record must force unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict before BLOCK evaluation; DET blockers remain visibly retained in the blocking array with prerequisite_indeterminate=true in coverage.

Finding identity for prerequisite-scoped findings uses a canonical four-field UTF-8 length-prefixed encoding (version, text, criteria, prerequisite_id) hashed to SHA-256; all non-prerequisite findings retain the legacy pipe-delimited encoding byte-for-byte.

Singleton focused finder must reach >=0.90 recall, <=0.10 false acceptance, 1.00 coverage completeness, and 0.00 attribution error before packed production route is implemented; packed route must maintain singleton metrics without regression and exit 0 on baseline comparison.

General and focused index verification domains are reshaped independently and cannot shift each other; the single Pass-3 execution-review pipeline applies to all findings after both domains are decided and concatenated; focused findings surface with prerequisite_id and no general index aliasing.
